submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the token that completes a conventional multi-token expression: a verb plus its idiomatic particle or preposition (rushed into, stared at, follows directly from), a fixed adjective-noun phrase (golden brown), or a similarly stereotyped slot (def add, after three), with strength graded by how strongly the preceding one or two tokens license the current one. Same-token context breaks collapse firing while distant meaning changes do not; early-position subword onsets (They h, def xyz) fire via the opposite SwiGLU sign regime (g+u+ vs the dominant g-u-) and are a separate offshoot this claim does not cover.
